question: I need you to look into the actor collaborations and tell me how many actors have made more films with Yash Chopra than with any other director. This will help us understand his influence on the industry better.
sql:
WITH yash_films AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MID 
    FROM M_Director 
    WHERE PID = 'nm0007181'
),
actor_yash_collab AS (
    SELECT M_Cast.PID, COUNT(*) as yash_count
    FROM M_Cast
    JOIN yash_films ON M_Cast.MID = yash_films.MID
    GROUP BY M_Cast.PID
),
actor_other_collabs AS (
    SELECT ac.PID, d.PID as director_pid, COUNT(*) as collab_count
    FROM actor_yash_collab ac
    JOIN M_Cast mc ON ac.PID = mc.PID
    JOIN M_Director d ON mc.MID = d.MID
    WHERE d.PID != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY ac.PID, d.PID
),
actor_max_other AS (
    SELECT PID, MAX(collab_count) as max_other
    FROM actor_other_collabs
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT ay.PID, p.Name, ay.yash_count, COALESCE(ao.max_other, 0) as max_other
FROM actor_yash_collab ay
JOIN Person p ON ay.PID = p.PID
LEFT JOIN actor_max_other ao ON ay.PID = ao.PID
ORDER BY ay.yash_count DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH yash_films AS (
    -- Get all movies directed by Yash Chopra
    SELECT DISTINCT MID 
    FROM M_Director 
    WHERE PID = 'nm0007181'
),
actor_yash_collab AS (
    -- Get actors who worked with Yash and their count
    SELECT M_Cast.PID, COUNT(*) as yash_count
    FROM M_Cast
    JOIN yash_films ON M_Cast.MID = yash_films.MID
    GROUP BY M_Cast.PID
),
actor_all_collabs AS (
    -- For each actor who worked with Yash, get their collaboration count with all directors
    SELECT ac.PID, d.PID as director_pid, COUNT(*) as collab_count
    FROM actor_yash_collab ac
    JOIN M_Cast mc ON ac.PID = mc.PID
    JOIN M_Director d ON mc.MID = d.MID
    GROUP BY ac.PID, d.PID
),
actor_max_other AS (
    -- Get max collaboration count for each actor with directors other than Yash
    SELECT PID, MAX(collab_count) as max_other_count
    FROM actor_all_collabs
    WHERE director_pid != 'nm0007181'
    GROUP BY PID
)
SELECT ay.PID, p.Name, ay.yash_count, COALESCE(ao.max_other_count, 0) as max_other
FROM actor_yash_collab ay
JOIN Person p ON ay.PID = p.PID
LEFT JOIN actor_max_other ao ON ay.PID = ao.PID
WHERE ay.yash_count > COALESCE(ao.max_other_count, 0)
ORDER BY ay.yash_count DESC
